purpose: Independent held-out evaluation of the existing E2 reranker candidate against its parent. The candidate was trained under the E2 protocol; this arm performs no new optimization.
metric: record recall@1/@4 from the learned reranker over the eligible lexical candidate pool; max span score per record; 16-unit bank

decision_rule.reject: candidate held-out top1 below parent or dev loss
decision_rule.accept: candidate held-out top1 above parent and dev not below parent

controls: lexical ordering reference (computed from the same pool)
retention: Keep parent and candidate extensions, raw rankings and rejection artifact. No base copy or download.
claims: Neural candidate acceptance/rejection on a small exposed retrieval set; no broad retrieval-quality or task-benefit claim.
